role: nonempty outcome space
notes: The general space need not be finite or countable.

role: all bounded real-valued gambles on the outcome space
notes: Payoffs use a specified linear utility scale.

role: event algebra on the stated outcome space
notes: A sigma algebra is an additional assumption in the countable-additivity theorem.

role: uniform closure of the finite-valued simple gambles on the algebra
notes: For the power-set algebra this is all bounded gambles; no replacement of the algebra by its generated sigma algebra is made.

role: domain of assessed gambles
notes: The domain is an arbitrary subset of the full gamble space and need not be a vector space.

role: indicator gamble of an event in the algebra
notes: An event outside the stated algebra is not silently assigned probability zero.

role: assessed supremum buying-price functional
notes: The actual acceptance of a gamble at its supremum price is not determined by this number.

role: infimum selling-price functional conjugate to the lower assessment
notes: The conjugate domain is the negative of the assessed domain.

role: centered assessed buying gain
notes: G of f is f minus its lower assessed price; portfolio criteria use pointwise suprema.

role: natural extension of the lower assessment
notes: Finite exactly in the sure-loss-avoiding case; least coherent dominating full-domain functional.

role: conjugate upper natural extension
notes: Equals the largest expectation among the compatible finitely additive models.

role: full-domain lower-prevision functional in the coherence characterization
notes: This I is a functional rather than an event indicator; indicator notation always has an event subscript.

role: positive normalized linear prevision
notes: Corresponds to a finitely additive probability on the selected event algebra.

role: closed convex set of all compatible linear previsions
notes: Contains every precise model dominating the assessments; it is nonempty exactly when sure loss is avoided.

role: full and reduced six-permutation prior hulls in the event-information example
notes: The hulls have equal event envelopes but different expectations for the specified utility vector.

role: ordered possibility score nested focal set and its difference mass
notes: The bridge uses the P14 definitions; it does not duplicate the finite comparison table.

role: conditional positive normalized linear prevision supported on the observed event
notes: Bayes-compatible pairs retain the zero-mass branch rather than dividing by zero.

role: Bayesian conditional associated with a positive-mass compatible model
notes: Its numerator is the expectation of the event-indicated gamble and its denominator is the positive event probability.

role: arbitrary separately and jointly coherent conditional lower prevision
notes: The full-domain one-event portfolio criterion forces the stated generalized-Bayes identity.

role: regular conditional lower prevision
notes: Uses positive-mass compatible models; the all-zero-mass case has an explicit vacuous convention.

role: generalized-Bayes root functional of a candidate conditional price
notes: Unique root requires positive lower event probability; at zero lower and positive upper probability the root set is a half-line.

role: coordinates of the declared binary product outcome space
notes: The strong-product and conditional assertions refer to this specified full product space.
